when: Open the application entry and inspect banner, Search, Products, Log in, Sign up, Main navigation, Question feed and its retry-question summary, then the two linked widgets.
then: Banner shows Stack Overflow and its account/search actions. Navigation exposes Home, Questions, Tags and Users; feed exposes Ask Question, Newest and Active. The retry summary has its exact title, node.js/http/retry tags and votes/answers/views metadata. The Overflow Blog and Hot Network Questions are visible with public links.

actionsAndAssertions.code: for (const name of ['Products','Log in','Sign up']) await expect(action(page.getByRole('banner'), name)).toBeVisible();
for (const name of ['Home','Questions','Tags','Users']) await expect(action(mainNav(page), name)).toBeVisible();
for (const name of ['Ask Question','Newest','Active']) await expect(action(feed, name)).toBeVisible();
for (const tag of ['node.js','http','retry']) await expectVisibleText(summary, tag);
for (const metric of ['Score','Answer count','View count']) await expect(output(summary, metric)).toHaveText(/^-?\d+$/);

coverage.review: Banner identity/search/account entries, four navigation actions, feed ordering controls, exact retry identity/tags, numeric metrics and linked widgets are observed. It does not compare screenshots or prove every historical metric equals its initial seed.
coverage.evidenceBoundary: Source-to-test review and bounded oracle contracts; no complete generated application was read or executed.

findings.explanation: Empty result/list region either had an unjustified area requirement or could disappear while child count=0 passed.
findings.resolution: Require one publicly exposed named region, allowing zero-area empty content; hidden/missing regions cannot satisfy semantic lookup.

findings.resolution: Accept visible public time metadata and common UTC clock/date/relative text; retain scoped author/body and persistence checks. This is timestamp presence, not proof of its exact instant.
findings.validation: Task-only TypeScript passed; new positive/negative browser contracts delegated to parent for execution.

limitations: This is a model-assisted review of a derivative benchmark, not upstream official certification or human annotation.
No generated applications or scores were consulted; no application/controller/source-requirement data was modified.
The 66-scenario denominator is preserved. Expired-comment boundaries and identified broader editor/rendering/history behaviors remain unmeasured.
Public UI privacy/ownership checks do not certify private endpoint authorization or internal database retention.
Date/time parsers cover stated UTC and ordinary English presentations; this does not establish zero false negatives across all international display formats.
Role/name conventions explicitly stated in the benchmark remain scoring contracts; passing them is not a complete real-world quality metric.
